name: FSL Eddy-correct
summary: Corrects eddy-current distortion and motion in a DWI with FSL eddy_correct (affine registration to a reference volume) and rotates the bvecs.
description: Runs FSL eddy_correct against the chosen reference volume and rotates the bvecs with fdt_rotate_bvecs using the resulting .ecclog. Use it for data already corrected with topup or data that cannot be corrected with topup; FSL eddy (OpenMP/CUDA Apps) is the more complete alternative.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvecs and bvals.

outputs.description: DWI after eddy_correct, with rotated bvecs and the original bvals.

parameters.description: Index of the volume used as the registration reference for eddy_correct (zero-based; default 0 = first volume).

citations.text: Smith SM, Jenkinson M, Woolrich MW, et al. Advances in functional and structural MR image analysis and implementation as FSL. NeuroImage 23(S1):208-219 (2004).

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check derivatives and logs
failure_modes.cause: output/dwi.nii.gz was not produced by eddy_correct.
